description.text: The eighth Black & White set, released on 6 February 2013 with 138 cards: 135 and three secret rares, Charizard, Blastoise and Random Receiver. It opened the Team Plasma sets: Team Plasma cards have a blue border and the team's shield, and other attacks and Trainers refer to them. Its Pokémon-EX include Lugia-EX, Victini-EX and Cobalion-EX and the three legendary birds, and it has three new ACE SPEC cards.
